title: Show model thinking rows in the dashboard sortie view
goal: The sortie view shows "Misato thinking (model) · 69 s" rows in order next to the EVA rows
acceptance: A test across the API and the dashboard rendering: a sortie with model rounds renders one row per round with role, model and seconds, in event order with the EVA rows
A round with no recorded model shows the role only; text follows docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md and var(--…) tokens
privacy: Neutral invented sorties and model names only.
escalation: A new visual element or token goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: rows in the sortie view from the new rounds field and a render test. Not a measurement.
